projects.title: qaic-prometheus-exporter
projects.description: Prometheus exporter for Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 accelerators. Scrapes qaic-util every 15 seconds and exposes 20+ per-QID metrics (power, temperature, DRAM, NSP utilization, inference load). Injected as a ConfigMap, no custom image needed.

projects.title: llms-or-naive-bayes
projects.description: Reproduction artifact for the PEARC '26 paper 'LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways'. Complement Naive Bayes vs zero/few-shot LLMs across four model families and a 37x scale range, with a Helm operator that picks the model by policy.

projects.title: nrp-header-collection
projects.description: Minimal sFlow collector for Kubernetes: listens on UDP/6343 behind a ClusterIP service, decodes samples to JSON (sflowtool -J) or PCAP (-t), and self-tests with a synthetic packet. The practical way to get real packet data on the National Research Platform.

projects.title: rucio-sense-dmm
projects.description: The Data Movement Manager: the interface layer between Rucio/FTS and SENSE so high-energy physics transfers can request SDN circuits. X.509 and SENSE OAuth credentials, Helm on NRP, web UI with site refresh. My working fork of the Rucio-SENSE interop effort.

projects.title: ESnet SmartNIC: hw, tutorial, bitfiles
projects.description: The ESnet SmartNIC line: SN1022-based hardware bring-up (esnet-smartnic-hw-sn1022), the 'Using Xilinx Alveo FPGAs as SmartNICs with ESnet Framework' tutorial with its [video series](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5Ght4QkHL8Sd7rTLNPv3TjYCZ3GorqPE), and a bitfile builder for reproducible builds.

projects.title: P4-on-Xilinx-FPGAs
projects.description: Docs and examples for running P4 programs on Xilinx FPGAs: Vivado for the hardware side, P4 tools for the language side, and the glue in between. Where I learned that packet processing is a memory budget, not a clock speed.

projects.title: Baseball-WAR-in-R
projects.description: Wins Above Replacement in R. A forever side project about park factors, positional adjustments, and the argument that any WAR number is only as good as its assumptions.

projects.title: ebpf-generator
projects.description: Java eBPF bytecode generator plus PCAP tools: custom packet filter rules compiled to eBPF, a PCAP reader/writer, packet filtering and manipulation, and an IPv4 packet generator.

projects.title: 7NRP-AI-Presentation
projects.description: The 30-minute AI infrastructure talk from the 7th National Research Platform Workshop (2026, UC San Diego / SDSC), built with Slidev.

projects.title: ImageColorization
projects.description: Grayscale image colorization with CNNs and GANs, built for CS 512 Computer Vision at Illinois Tech.

projects.title: Single-Image-Facial-Superresolution-GAN
projects.description: Single-image facial super-resolution with GANs, built for CS 584 at Illinois Tech.

projects.title: NBAmazonReviews
projects.description: Amazon reviews classification experiments, the seed of the Naive Bayes benchmarking work that became PEARC '26.
